scope: Common service/frame admission, image/asset recovery, shader-mask composition and input shutdown. This contract is a functional bundle within the remaining W9-03 priority scope.

requirements.required: A failed host request leaves no inaccessible callback or active ticker. endOfFrame and ticker start can retry. Cancellation, next-frame scheduling, hidden/resume and View isolation remain observable.

Removed observers and closed owners receive no later notification. A reentrant newer environment suppresses stale delivery. Cleanup attempts all owned releases. Async keyboard initialization preserves user callbacks and unsubscribes before transport retirement.

Failed string reads can retry; concurrent reads deduplicate; eviction cannot be undone by late parse completion. SDK bootstrap connects OS memory pressure to only this app's image/asset caches while live image handles survive.
Headers are immutable cache inputs; fit resizing never creates a zero-pixel dimension; cancellation suppresses later progress; synchronous host frame callbacks release the returned lease.

An explicit percent-encoded file:/// URI uses separate native IO without relaxing asset confinement. Enforce regular-file/nonempty/16 MiB limits, surface IO errors, cancel publication, and drain native completion before destroying the image backend. Older native suppliers fail explicitly. Web has no native file capability.

Mask after child paint in child-local coordinates using existing saveLayer/drawRect commands; preserve layout/hit testing and retained child composition. Borrow the callback's Shader; recorded frames retain independent image holds. Callback/paint failure rolls back and permits subsequent frames.

Mouse enter callbacks may hide/close their View without later enter callbacks. Root hide/metrics change cancels pointer contacts. Controller hidden/resume, completion and disposal preserve ticker lifetime. Existing keyboard/selection and font-change flows remain valid.

differences: Nelyx observers use live membership and latest-snapshot checks rather than reproducing every Flutter singleton/reentrant callback detail.
FileImage accepts an encoded local file URI instead of a Dart File object. File mutations require explicit eviction. Remote file authorities/content-provider URIs are outside this API.
Native file cancellation suppresses results; an already admitted bounded filesystem read may finish before drain. It does not claim interruptible OS file IO.
ShaderMask uses the existing retained canvas scope; a separate Flutter engine ShaderMaskLayer hierarchy is not required for this implementation. Shader objects remain caller-owned.
numericPolicy: Finite milliseconds for scheduling; safe integer identities and lengths; positive bounded image dimensions, at least one pixel after fit rounding; existing wire/ARGB/sRGB rules. No Dart-generated declarations or new numeric lowering in this bundle.
evidencePolicy: Controlled host/codec checks, real CPU pixels, browser WebGL/fixture ingress, native C++ IO, native JSI application frame admission and copied-artifact exit are distinct scopes. No physical IME/reader/FPS or full recovery acceptance follows from these checks.
deferredByUser: Embedded native/HTML views and dedicated acceptance
remainingPriorityAudit: Full common platform/service/worker owner closure beyond the named contracts
Remaining paint/layer/filter/image formats and restoration fidelity, including rawUnmodified, wide-gamut and raster-cache scope decisions
